tools.name: Two-Phase Nonisothermal Zero-Gap Alkaline Water Electrolyzer [Fuel Cell & Electrolyzer Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the Fuel Cell & Electrolyzer Module (Electrolyzers): Two-Phase Nonisothermal Zero-Gap Alkaline Water Electrolyzer. Physics interfaces: Darcy's Law (dl), Heat Transfer in Solids and Fluids (ht), PhaseTransportFreePorous (phtr), Laminar Flow (spf), Water Electrolyzer (we). Multiphysics couplings: Electrochemical Heating, Mixture Model, Multiphase Flow in Porous Media, NavierStokesDarcyCoupling. Study steps: Current Distribution Initialization, Stationary. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("Fuel_Cell_and_Electrolyzer_Module/Electrolyzers/zero_gap_aec") to solve it, comsol_example_info("zero_gap_aec", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > Fuel Cell and Electrolyzer Module > Electrolyzers > zero gap aec
